consequence.statement: Waypoint pod affinity can now be configured through the waypoint.affinity Helm value; existing deployments without this value continue to work with default affinity behavior.

assertion.statement: Waypoint pod affinity configuration is now available via the `.Values.waypoint.affinity` Helm value in Istio 1.24.0.
